items.docs: Returns the secret keys (not values) configured for a Streamlit application. Secret values are never returned via the API for security.

params.name: appId
params.description: The unique identifier of the Streamlit app

items.docs: Replaces all secrets for a Streamlit application. Secrets are provided as a TOML-formatted string and are made available in the app via st.secrets. Updating secrets automatically restarts the application.
